description: Refactor QRMenu.vue to use new components and composables, reduce from ~717 lines to ~200 lines. Fix critical order ID tracking bug: ensure order_id from API response is correctly stored and passed to OrderStatusPage after order placement. Fix localStorage data persistence for OrderPaymentSuccessPage after Chapa redirect.
steps: 1. Refactor QRMenu.vue script section: Import and use useQRMenuCart, useQRMenuContext, useQRMenuOrder composables. Remove duplicate state/logic now in composables (lines 173-226: interfaces, cart state, computed values). Keep only QRMenuLayout interaction logic and modal visibility state. Replace direct API calls with composable methods. Maintain existing event handlers but delegate to composable methods.

2. Refactor QRMenu.vue template section: Replace inline cart modal (lines 22-147) with <QRCartModal> component. Replace inline payment dialog (lines 192-285) with <QRPaymentDialog> component. Replace inline success modal (lines 288-346) with <QROrderSuccessModal> component. Pass props from composable state to components. Wire component emits to composable methods.

3. FIX CRITICAL BUG in order placement flow (placeOrderWithRoomCharge method): After unifiedOrderService.createOrder succeeds, extract order ID from response: const createdOrderId = orderResponse.data.id || orderResponse.data.order_id. Build complete order data object with items array: { ...orderResponse.data, id: createdOrderId, order_id: createdOrderId, items: cartItems.map(...), subtotal, tax, service_charge, total, status: 'pending', payment_status: 'pending', payment_type: 'room_charge', created_at, updated_at }. Store to localStorage 'pending_order_data': localStorage.setItem('pending_order_data', JSON.stringify(completeOrderData)). Store hotel_id if present: if (orderResponse.data.hotel_id) localStorage.setItem('hotel_id', orderResponse.data.hotel_id). Store qr_token: localStorage.setItem('guest_qr_token', qrToken). Then navigate to order-status: router.push({ name: 'order-status', params: { orderId: createdOrderId }, query: { hotel_id: orderResponse.data.hotel_id, qr_token: qrToken, order_number: orderResponse.data.order_number } }). This fixes the bug where OrderStatusPage cannot find order ID because pending_order_data was incomplete. Reference existing logic in QRMenu.vue lines 313-375 and useOrderStatus.ts lines 108-140.

4. FIX CRITICAL BUG in Chapa payment flow (initializeWalkInPayment method): After unifiedOrderService.initializeWalkInPayment succeeds, build payment data object: { payment_id: paymentResponse.payment_id, tx_ref: paymentResponse.tx_ref, amount: paymentResponse.amount, qr_token, table_number: orderContext.displayName, items: cartItems.map(item => ({ name, quantity, price, total: price * quantity })), calculation: paymentResponse.calculation }. Store to BOTH localStorage AND sessionStorage with key 'walk_in_payment_data': localStorage.setItem('walk_in_payment_data', JSON.stringify(paymentData)); sessionStorage.setItem('walk_in_payment_data', JSON.stringify(paymentData)). This fixes the bug where OrderPaymentSuccessPage cannot find tx_ref or order data after Chapa redirect because sessionStorage was cleared. Using both storages ensures data persists through redirect. Reference existing logic in QRMenu.vue lines 538-565 and OrderPaymentSuccessPage.vue lines 173-229.

5. Update formatPrice helper function: Change from `return $${price.toFixed(2)}` to `return ETB ${price.toFixed(2)}`. Ensure this helper is used consistently in all cart/payment/success components. Verify no hardcoded '$' or 'ETB $' formats remain in QRMenu.vue or child components.

6. Final integration testing: Test complete flow: QR scan -> menu display -> add items -> view cart (verify ETB formatting) -> place room charge order (verify order ID stored and passed to OrderStatusPage) -> verify OrderStatusPage loads with order data. Test walk-in flow: add items -> pay with Chapa -> verify payment data stored to both storages -> redirect to Chapa -> after payment, verify OrderPaymentSuccessPage finds tx_ref and order data -> click Track Order -> verify OrderStatusPage loads with order ID from API.
acceptance_criteria: QRMenu.vue reduced from ~717 lines to ~200 lines by using components and composables
All existing functionality preserved: QR token detection, room/table context, guest info, cart operations, quantity controls, calculations, room charge ordering, Chapa payment, order status redirect
Order ID tracking bug fixed: After room charge order placement, OrderStatusPage receives order ID via route params and can load order data (no 'No order ID found' error)
Chapa payment bug fixed: After Chapa redirect, OrderPaymentSuccessPage finds tx_ref from localStorage/sessionStorage and can complete payment (no 'No tx_ref found' error)
Currency formatting fixed: All prices display 'ETB XX.XX' format consistently (no '$' or 'ETB $')
TypeScript compilation succeeds: 'npm run type-check' passes
verification: Run 'npm run type-check' - no TypeScript errors

Start dev server 'npm run dev' and test complete room charge order flow: QR scan -> add items -> view cart -> click 'Order Now (Pay After Meal)' -> verify redirect to order-status page with orderId in URL -> verify OrderStatusPage loads order data without errors -> check browser console for '[useOrderStatus] Using stored order data from order creation' message

Test walk-in Chapa payment flow: add items -> click 'Pay with Chapa' -> fill customer form -> click 'Pay Now' -> verify redirect to Chapa (or error if Chapa unavailable) -> check localStorage and sessionStorage contain 'walk_in_payment_data' with tx_ref -> simulate Chapa return by navigating to /order/payment/success?tx_ref=TEST123 -> verify OrderPaymentSuccessPage finds tx_ref and displays payment receipt -> click 'Track My Order' -> verify navigation to order-status page
Verify currency formatting: inspect all price displays in cart modal, payment dialog, success modal - all should show 'ETB XX.XX' format
Check QRMenu.vue line count: should be ~200 lines (down from ~717 lines)
Manual test all cart operations: add item, increment quantity, decrement quantity, remove item - verify cart updates correctly
findings: Current QRMenu.vue is 717 lines with template (lines 1-171) and script (lines 173-717). Major logic sections: interfaces (lines 175-186), reactive state (lines 188-213), computed values (lines 215-226), event handlers (lines 228-262), order placement methods (lines 264-446: placeOrderWithRoomCharge for room charge, openPaymentDialog/closePaymentDialog/proceedToPayment for Chapa flow, handlePlaceOrder for both flows), track order handlers (lines 448-456), QR context detection (lines 458-705: detectOrderContext with qrService.resolveQRToken). CRITICAL BUGS IDENTIFIED: (1) Order ID not passed to OrderStatusPage - placeOrderWithRoomCharge method (lines 313-375) creates order but only stores partial data to pending_order_data, missing order_id field. OrderStatusPage useOrderStatus composable (lines 108-140) checks pending_order_data for order ID but doesn't find it, logs error '[OrderPaymentSuccess] No order ID found'. FIX: Store complete order data with id field. (2) tx_ref not found after Chapa redirect - handlePlaceOrder method (lines 538-565) stores walk_in_payment_data to sessionStorage but Chapa redirect clears sessionStorage. OrderPaymentSuccessPage (lines 173-229) checks sessionStorage and doesn't find data, logs error '[OrderPaymentSuccess] No tx_ref found'. FIX: Store to both localStorage AND sessionStorage. (3) Currency formatting inconsistency - formatPrice function (line 311) returns `$${price.toFixed(2)}` but user wants 'ETB' format. Some places use 'ETB $' mixed format. FIX: Change formatPrice to return 'ETB XX.XX' consistently.
